desc:
🐟 Catch and fight fish with your friends! 🤑

🚤 You were having a fun day exploring the waters and crashed your boat.
🐟 Catch and fight fish for cash
💰 Use the money to buy new lures and weapons.
🌙 Survive the wild creatures of the ocean...
🙏 Survive to return home.

[#] New islands coming soon!
[#] Updates every week!
[#] Play with friends to beat bosses easier!

Controls

🖥️ PC: Left Click / Right Click / Q / E / Shift
📱 Mobile: On-screen buttons

🚧 The game is still in beta, and we’re improving it every day!

Enjoy the game! Leave a like and join the group to support us!
Inspired from the game How to Fish
